name: search-hole
description: A local search gateway for AI assistants: choose the engines and sites your AI searches, see every search, get source receipts.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key (optional)
brave_api_key.description: Optional extra engine. Brave's API asks for a card; see https://brave.com/search/api/ for its current free credit and terms. Leave empty to skip.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key (optional)
tavily_api_key.description: Optional extra engine with the easiest free plan: 1,000 credits a month, no credit card (a search costs one credit, a deep search two). Sign up at https://app.tavily.com and paste the key. Leave empty to skip.
